challenge.method: Checked the annotated tag target and moving seeAlso locator, tested raw equality, ran the prescribed one-LF comparison, and separately compared the branding passage at bytes [800,1832) in both texts.
challenge.results: The release target matched. Raw equality was false. Appending exactly one LF produced all 2,820 decoded bytes and the prescribed result was true for BSD-3-Clause-OpenWebUI. The branding passage matched directly, including its exceptions and material-breach language.

limitations: The SPDX seeAlso URL uses main. The result applies only to the pinned project commit and release detail.
